title: What the solver's log says about a hint
heading: Only the Log Says Whether a Hint Was Used
cases: a HiGHS log with an accepted MIP start reads as accepted, and one with the cannot-yield line reads as rejected
CP-SAT logs read as accepted, partial and repairing for a complete feasible, an incomplete and an infeasible hint
a HiGHS log that completes a partial hint into a feasible MIP start reads as partial
a SCIP log with no line about the hint reads as unknown, and one with the candidate line as accepted
